# MegiLance

> MegiLance is an AI-powered freelance marketplace that connects businesses with top-tier freelance talent using machine learning matching, secure escrow payments, and real-time collaboration tools.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://megilance.site/): Main landing page and platform overview.
- [Browse Freelancers](https://megilance.site/freelancers): Discover verified top-tier freelancers.
- [Browse Gigs](https://megilance.site/gigs): Explore fixed-price freelancer services.
- [Browse Jobs](https://megilance.site/jobs): Find open projects and freelance opportunities.
- [Hire Freelancers](https://megilance.site/hire): Hire freelancers organized by specialized skills.
- [Features](https://megilance.site/features): Detailed overview of AI talent matching and platform tools.
- [Pricing](https://megilance.site/pricing): Transparent pricing plans for clients and freelancers.
- [AI Matching](https://megilance.site/ai-matching): Demonstration of ML skill scoring and candidate ranking.
- [Cost Calculator](https://megilance.site/cost-calculator): Estimate project costs and platform fee savings.
- [Compare Platforms](https://megilance.site/compare): Side-by-side comparison with Upwork and Fiverr.
- [Post a Project](https://megilance.site/post-project): Client project submission portal.
- [FAQ](https://megilance.site/faq): Frequently asked questions about payments, security, and usage.
- [Enterprise](https://megilance.site/enterprise): Custom solutions for enterprise organizations.

## Overview

MegiLance offers flat 5% service fees, milestone-based escrow payments via Stripe, real-time messaging, verified profiles, and AI-powered talent matching.

Core Value Propositions:
- AI talent matching: ML model analyzes skill compatibility, past performance, and budget fit.
- Low service fee: Flat 5% service fee on free tier, reduced on Pro.
- Escrow protection: Milestone-based escrow payments via Stripe and crypto.
- Real-time collaboration: Integrated chat and project management tools.

## Pricing Summary

- Free Plan: Free profile creation, 10 project applications per month, standard AI matching, 15% platform fee on earnings.
- Pro Freelancer ($19/month): Unlimited job applications, priority AI matching & placement, reduced 8% platform fee, market analytics.
- Enterprise: Custom pricing for enterprise clients.

## Skill Categories

Web development (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI), Mobile development (Flutter, React Native, iOS, Android), Design & UI/UX (Figma, Graphic design), Data & AI (Machine learning, Data engineering), DevOps & Cloud (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes), Technical Writing & Content, Digital Marketing, Business & Management.
